mosasaurus.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one beautiful canonical paleoart image of Mosasaurus hoffmannii for a realistic prehistoric marine animal game. No fin on the back. Fine small reptile scales, dark slate charcoal dorsal skin with restrained olive mottling fading into pale gray cream underside, living skin with subtle irregularities. Naturalistic high-end 3D-style paleoart, convincing large animal mass, beautiful shafts of filtered surface sunlight and blue underwater depth, suspended particles, distant pale seafloor barely visible below. This is a clear canonical anatomy portrait in a dynamic ocean setting, not a feeding or attack scene.

archelon.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original high-quality canonical paleoart image of Archelon ischyros for a realistic prehistoric marine animal game, in a wide landscape 3:2 frame. Dynamic elevated front-left three-quarter view, head toward left, broad carapace shown from above, modest foreshortening. The whole animal, every flipper tip and tail tip inside image with comfortable margins; no cropping. Archelon anatomy is crucial: large elongated narrow turtle skull with strongly hooked toothless upper beak, a short stout extended neck, broad low gently flattened leathery carapace supported by underlying ribs with subtly scalloped edges. Small single tapered pointed tail projects from exact center behind shell between hindflippers. No feet or protruding toes or extra appendages. Beautiful naturalistic high-end 3D-style paleoart with subtle filtered sunlight, realistic skin microtexture, ocean depth and suspended particles; massive living animal, graceful swimming, calm blue space around silhouette. No other foreground animals, no plants covering animal, no fish fused to flippers, no labels, text, watermark, logos, border or multi-panel layout. Scientific anatomy portrait, not monster design.
archelon.visualReview: Complete turtle including four separate flippers and central pointed tail. Front flippers much larger than rear paddles.
